method: Read-only lipo -archs and otool -arch <slice> -l inspection of every non-symlink Mach-O. No execution.

higherMinimumOS: Both bundles include runtime/ollama/mlx_metal_v4/{libjaccl,libmlx,libmlxc,libollama_xgrammar}.dylib, arm64-only, minOS26.2. Runtime selection/fallback on macOS14 is unverified.
architectureNotes: ARM-only Ollama mlx_metal_v4 files are also shipped in Intel app as unused backend payload; the executable architecture guard does not cover them.
Intel-only Ollama root dylibs are dependencies of Intel llama-server slice; ARM llama-server slice has no such direct dependencies.
Matching Sharp, libvips, and @napi-rs/canvas native modules are present in each bundle.
loaderPathNotes: All inspected LC_LOAD_DYLIB/LC_LOAD_WEAK_DYLIB/LC_REEXPORT_DYLIB paths are system locations or loader/executable/rpath relative paths. No absolute build-machine dependency was found.

Parakeet/Catalog include an absolute private Swift-toolchain LC_RPATH after /usr/lib/swift and @loader_path. This is a build-path leak; direct loaded Swift dependencies use system /usr/lib/swift paths.
Ollama Intel CPU libraries include absolute build-runner LC_RPATH after @loader_path; shipped relative dependencies resolve in the runtime directory.
Canvas absolute /Users/runner/.../libcanvas.dylib is LC_ID_DYLIB (self install-name), not a loaded dependency.
Electron framework dependencies use inherited main/helper Frameworks rpaths; files are present in Contents/Frameworks.
limits: Minimum deployment metadata and static paths do not prove every imported OS API is available on macOS14.
No macOS14 host execution, Rosetta execution, dynamic backend-selection test, or GUI check performed.
The optional Ollama26.2 backend requires runtime version-gating/fallback evidence before claiming all shipped AI backends support macOS14.

managedChildMitigation.sourceFinding: Upstream compatibility filter checks macOS major <26 for Metal4; shipped ARM Metal4 libraries declare26.2. Explicit mlx variant override is supported by the loader.
managedChildMitigation.implementation: App-owned darwin/arm64 child selects mlx_metal_v3 below26.2 or unknown product version; preserves explicit backend overrides. Intel/upstream selection and healthy external servers are unchanged.
